senses.gloss: h. a. ch. (= כִּ (וון) לאפי, v. אַף, אַפָּא a. כּוּן) directed towards, opposite, against.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 24:15">Targ. Job XXIV, 15</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 6:4">Snh. VI, 4</cite> <he>פניו כ׳ העם</he> his (the culprit’s) face towards the people; <he>כ׳ העץ</he> towards the cross. Ib. 105ᵃ, v. <cite ref="H00437"><he>חוּצְפָּא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Pesachim 8b:7">Pes. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>כ׳ שאמרה תורה</he> in the face of what (considering that) the Law says; Y. Macc. II, 31ᵈ top <he>כ׳ שנאמר</he>; a. fr.—<he>כ׳ לייא</he>, <cite ref="A01839"><he>אליה</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="A01839"><he>אַלְיָה</he></cite>.
